production.note: Some Forever baseline learning may be available at character level 1. The Classic production reference begins at level 5; the current Forever training gates have not been confirmed.

gathering.note: Apprentice and Journeyman have no character-level gate in the Classic reference; level 1 is shown as the lowest playable level.

methods: Expert Fishing — The Bass and You
fishing.note: Classic Expert Fishing is learned from a book requiring character level 20 and Fishing 125. Artisan is unlocked through Nat Pagle's quest at character level 35 and Fishing 225. Forever may use different training methods.

cooking.note: Classic Cooking has no character-level gate for Apprentice, Journeyman or the Expert book. Artisan requires the level-35 quest at Cooking 225. Forever training methods are unverified.

first-aid.note: Classic First Aid has no character-level gate for Apprentice, Journeyman or the Expert book. Artisan requires the level-35 Triage quest at First Aid 225. Forever training methods are unverified.
